app.name: Jaga
app.description: Flood alerts and emergency help for Pattani, Yala, Narathiwat and Songkhla

home.title: Jaga is getting ready for the flood season
home.body: This app doesn't issue alerts yet. Follow official warnings from DDPM and local authorities.
home.emergency: In an emergency, call 1784 or 1669 straight from the buttons below

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: The hotlines below still work. The app reloads when you're back online.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.visitorNote: You don't need to sign in to send an SOS, see alerts or call the hotlines.

line.title: Residents and response units
line.note: Sign in to get your tambon's alerts in LINE and to save your home and the places you watch.
line.appHint: If LINE asks for an email and password, tap the link to log in with the LINE app at the bottom of that page.
line.unavailable: Sign-in with LINE isn't available yet.

phone.title: Sign in with your phone number
phone.label: Mobile number

admin.label: Invited email address
admin.note: Open the link from the email in this browser. It works once.

sent.email: If this address was invited, we've sent it a sign-in link. Check the inbox.

error.link: That link doesn't work or has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.line: Sign-in with LINE didn't work. Try again.
error.sms: We couldn't send the code. Try again.
error.code: That code is wrong or has expired.
error.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unavailable: This way of signing in isn't available right now.

setup.title: About you
setup.intro: Only your name is needed to start. Everything else is optional.

name.label: Display name
name.hint: A nickname is fine. Responders see this name when you ask for help.

phone.label: Phone number (optional)
phone.hint: Without a number, rescuers can't call you. Your number is never public.

home.title: Home location (optional)
home.why: Used to show your tambon's alerts and the safe places near your home.
home.failed: Couldn't find your location. Turn on GPS and try again, or skip this for now.
home.consent: I agree that Jaga stores my home location for alerts.
home.useMap: Choose the place on the map
home.mapHint: Tap the map where your home is. Zoom in to be more exact.
home.mapFailed: The map couldn't be loaded. Try again, or use your current location.

error.name: Enter a name (up to 80 characters).
error.consent: Tick the consent box to save your home location, or choose not to use it.

authority.title: For response units
authority.intro: Rescue teams, government units, foundations and volunteer teams register to receive requests for help in their area.
authority.registered: Registration sent. An admin will call the contact person before approving it.

status.pending: Waiting for an admin to verify

signedIn.title: You're signed in
signedIn.why: This sign-in started in another app or browser. Please check that this is your account.

authorityRegister.title: Register a response unit
authorityRegister.intro: After you send this form, a Jaga admin calls the contact person before approving it. Until then you won't see the personal data of people asking for help.

orgName.label: Organization or parent department
orgName.hint: If one team covers several areas, register each separately under the same organization name.

publicContact.label: Show this official phone to the public
publicContact.hint: Shown only after an admin has approved the unit. If you don't tick this, the number isn't shown.

poc.title: Contact person
poc.privacy: The contact's name and phone are never public. Only admins and units that share your coverage can see them, and every view is logged.
poc.name: Contact person's name
poc.phoneHint: An admin will call this number to confirm.

capability.label: What the unit can do (choose all that apply)

coordination.name: Coordination
coordination.hint: Takes requests and coordinates other units

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue.hint: Has a team and equipment to reach people

coverage.label: Coverage area
coverage.hint: Choose a whole province, a whole district, or single tambons.
coverage.unavailable: The list of areas couldn't be loaded. Try again later.
coverage.mapHint: Tap a tambon to select or unselect it. The list below follows.
coverage.mapLocked: This tambon is selected as part of a whole district or province. Undo that in the list below.
coverage.mapFailed: The map couldn't be loaded. Choose from the list below.

authorityRegister.afterSubmit: After you send it, the status stays "waiting" until an admin approves it.

error.pocPhone: The contact's phone number isn't valid.
error.officialPhone: The official phone number isn't valid.
error.limit: One account can register at most 5 units.

authorities.title: Verify response units
authorities.coverage: Selected: {provinces} provinces, {districts} districts, {tambons} tambons · {total} tambons in total
authorities.reveal: Show the contact's name and phone (logged every time)
authorities.called: I called this number and the contact confirmed the registration

error.call: Call the contact's phone to confirm it before approving.

invitations.title: Admins and invitations
invitations.how: No invitation email is sent automatically. Tell the person to open the sign-in page, choose "For admins" and enter this address. Invitations lapse after 14 days.

error.forbidden: Only the super admin can do this.
error.duplicate: This address already has a waiting invitation.
error.account: Couldn't create an account for this address. Try again.
error.unavailable: This deployment isn't set up to send invitations.

devBrand.title: Brand review
devBrand.note: Development and preview only. Not available in production.
devBrand.stale: Stale marker (beside the level, never instead of it)
